text:
ana (partnerships): Heads-up: preflight checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Goal: staging publishable bundle by Friday COB. Required: publisher account access, legal redline, SKU/pricing table, image manifest (AMI/container), sample deployment snippet, screenshots, trial entitlement mapping, and billing/meters. Please claim ownership.

kevin (eng): Ill take image manifest + deploy snippets. Plan to produce a single JSON index mapping sku->aws_amis/gcp_images/azure_blobs and a short terraform example. Will need PublisherAdmin on staging.

rachel (product): I'll handle SKU taxonomy and pricing tiers. Proposal: trial(14d), dev (token-limited), pro (quota + SLA). Will output pricing.csv and manifest mapping. Question: storefront should show single price; region availability in manifest OK?

diego (legal): I'll do EULA + privacy addendum redline. Need confirmation that no raw prompts are forwarded to marketplace telemetry and the retention period for aggregated telemetry (30/90 days). Azure needs FR/DE/JA copies 1 we'll budget translation time.

olga (ops): Billing needs X-RW-TENANT header, sku, units, region, usage_kind. Example meter body: {"sku":"RW-LLM-pro","units":1200,"region":"us-east-1"}. SDK must set tenant header or provide fallback.

tara (marketing): I'll prepare 1-line description + 3 bullets + 3 screenshots (dashboard, onboarding, billing). Please create staging org "Redwood Marketplace Staging" so screenshots are safe.

publisher-bot: staging publisher provisioned -> publisher_id=p-77665, console=https://staging-pub.redwood.example/login :white_check_mark:

ana (partnerships): Summary owners: kevin->images+snippets, rachel->sku+pricing, diego->legal, olga->metering, tara->marketing. I'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 10am PT to close blockers. Drop links to drafts here. Thanks!"
